chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 126: The Eternal Continent Beckons with Conflict
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen arrives on the Eternal Continent but clashes with the Undying Sect over the little defiant dragon. Keke's power and Xiao Chen's wit set the tone for new alliances.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch.126: Landing on the Eternal Continent
og_description: Xiao Chen sets foot on the Eternal Continent and immediately provokes the Undying Sect. A display of strength and cunning marks the start of a new chapter.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen, Yan Qingcheng, and Keke land on the Eternal Continent. The Undying Sect disciples challenge them, but Xiao Chen and Keke respond with overwhelming power.
